title: Warm Silky Filipino Beef Kaldereta
description: A sour and silky one-pot Filipino dish featuring scallions and halal-friendly ingredients, this kaldereta is a hearty and flavorful meal option. It combines the richness of beef with the brightness of citrus and the depth of spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the beef pieces until they are browned on all sides, then remove them from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped scallions to the pot and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the tomato paste, fish sauce, lime juice, black pepper, and salt to the pot, stirring to combine.
Add the browned beef pieces back to the pot, stirring to coat with the sauce.
Add the potatoes to the pot, stirring to combine with the sauce and beef.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the beef is tender and the potatoes are cooked through.
Serve the kaldereta hot, garnished with additional chopped scallions if desired.
